description: Dreamwalker Boots Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Boots if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 2 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Boots - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 12 - Mooncloth x 3 - Cured Rugged Hide x 2
name: Dreamwalker Boots
